claim: arbitrary DP DPRSC mechanisms require dimension-exponential additive error
certificate_kind: universally quantified SMT refutation; no finite graph enumeration

imported_lemmas: lem:lower bounds for disc of private orthogonal range counting

quantifier_scope.database_size: arbitrary n > 0 (real relaxation of positive integers)
quantifier_scope.dimension: arbitrary middle-regime d covered by imported discrepancy lemma
quantifier_scope.pattern: arbitrary pattern with positive global sensitivity

obligations.name: adjacency_preservation_per_coordinate
obligations.meaning: hypotheses AND NOT(conclusion) has no model
obligations.smt2:
(declare-fun x () Bool)
(declare-fun edge () Bool)
(declare-fun adjacency_preservation_per_coordinate_hypothesis_00 () Bool)
(declare-fun x_prime () Bool)
(declare-fun edge_prime () Bool)
(declare-fun adjacency_preservation_per_coordinate_hypothesis_01 () Bool)
(declare-fun adjacency_preservation_per_coordinate_hypothesis_02 () Bool)
(declare-fun adjacency_preservation_per_coordinate_negated_conclusion () Bool)
(assert (=> adjacency_preservation_per_coordinate_hypothesis_00 (= edge x)))
(assert (=> adjacency_preservation_per_coordinate_hypothesis_01 (= edge_prime x_prime)))
(assert (=> adjacency_preservation_per_coordinate_hypothesis_02 (distinct x x_prime)))
(assert (=> adjacency_preservation_per_coordinate_negated_conclusion
    (not (distinct edge edge_prime))))

obligations.name: deterministic_decoder_triangle_inequality

obligations.name: privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta
obligations.meaning: hypotheses AND NOT(conclusion) has no model
obligations.smt2:
(declare-fun k () Real)
(declare-fun privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_00
             ()
             Bool)
(declare-fun privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_01
             ()
             Bool)
(declare-fun alpha () Real)
(declare-fun privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_02
             ()
             Bool)
(declare-fun beta_threshold () Real)
(declare-fun privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_03
             ()
             Bool)
(declare-fun beta () Real)
(declare-fun privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_04
             ()
             Bool)
(declare-fun attack_fraction () Real)
(declare-fun privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_05
             ()
             Bool)
(declare-fun privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_negated_conclusion
             ()
             Bool)
(assert (=> privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_00 (> k 0.0)))
(assert (=> privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_01
    (<= k (/ 1.0 2.0))))
(assert (=> privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_02
    (= alpha (/ k 4.0))))
(assert (=> privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_03
    (= (* beta_threshold (- 1.0 alpha)) (- 1.0 k))))
(assert (=> privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_04
    (= beta (/ (+ 1.0 beta_threshold) 2.0))))
(assert (=> privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_hypothesis_05
    (= attack_fraction (+ (* beta alpha) (- 1.0 beta)))))
(assert (=> privacy_constants_exist_for_every_epsilon_delta_negated_conclusion
    (not (and (> alpha 0.0)
              (< alpha k)
              (< beta_threshold beta)
              (< beta 1.0)
              (< attack_fraction k)))))

obligations.name: discrepancy_lift_arbitrary_pattern_dimension

(declare-fun discrepancy_lift_arbitrary_pattern_dimension_hypothesis_02 () Bool)

    (> sensitivity 0.0)))

    (> point_disc 0.0)))
(assert (=> discrepancy_lift_arbitrary_pattern_dimension_hypothesis_02
    (>= remainder 0.0)))
